title: 第9章 冲突第10章 各方反应
content_zh:
李庆大笑时还不忘示意身边的人把萧天和叶净心围了起来。
李庆说起来也是一个名人，正如刚刚那些摊主所说，是一个极其好色之徒，而且手段残忍，但凡他看上的女人基本都没有能逃脱他的魔掌，最后被活活的折磨死。
所以人称色魔。
虽然人人都知道他的恶行，但是由于他是李家家主的儿子，而且李家这几年行事也是越来越嚣张跋扈，加上李庆本身也是锻体境三层天的高手，在南陵城这个小地方，同龄人中也是排得上号的了。
所以大伙也是只能忍气吞声了。
这也导致了李庆行事更加肆无忌惮。
现在主意都敢打在叶家的嫡女身上也就不足为奇了。
现在李庆身边跟的都是李家附属小家族的一些公子哥，也都是一些跋扈好色之徒。
正所谓是物以类聚人以群分。
而且每个人都是修为在身，最低的也是炼气九层天的修为。
这就导致了这个小团体就是城中的毒瘤，为祸人间。
看着李庆等人那嚣张模样，萧天也是怒火中烧，特别还是招惹他的女人，这是必然不能忍受的。
而且李庆等人明显是不把萧天放在眼里，毕竟萧天在南陵城也是“名人”
，怎么可能不认识，现在都没有跟萧天说话，对萧天的态度可想而知。
萧天也不废话，一步跨出，挡在了叶净心的前面。
从始至终，萧天的手一直紧紧握住叶净心的小手。
叶净心感受到了萧天对她的呵护，这让她很感动。
看到萧天这副模样，李庆戏谑道“哟，这不是萧家二少爷吗？怎么，就凭你这没有修为的废物也想拦我？好心劝你，不要自讨苦吃。
万一我一不留神把你打死了，我还得抗你回萧家，这一来一回，多影响我跟叶小姐亲热呀！
哈哈哈哈…”

萧天听到这话也不生气，非常平静。
之所以认为萧天还是废物，是因为在刚出叶家门口萧天就已经收敛气息了。
现在的萧天看着就是一个妥妥的凡人。
这个时候，萧天开口了“你最好现在给叶小姐道歉，我可以考虑放你离开，否则…”
“否则怎样，你要打我吗？来呀，来，试试能不能打到我。”
听到萧天的话，李庆就像是听到一个笑话，一脸欠揍的嘲讽道。
“你身为萧家二公子，难道不知道修炼者和普通人的差别吗？我一根手指头就能戳死你！
哈哈哈…”
萧天当然知道修炼者的厉害。
修炼者先炼气，打通全身一百零八处穴位后汇聚紫府丹田，后经锻体术，引动灵气锻造筋骨。
这些都是还是基础，所以修炼者的强大毋庸置疑的。
只是萧天也是一个修炼者，只是比较特殊的修炼者而已。
萧天凝声说道“废话这么多，要么道歉然后滚，要么直接躺下。”
李庆听到萧天如此不知死活，当下也不再伪装。
直接吩咐道“动手，不用顾忌，打死打残，我顶着，谁能先打趴这小子我奖励五块下品灵石！
！”
听到李庆这话，跟随李庆一起来的那六个公子哥立马摆出架势，同时体内丹田开始涌动，周身灵气开始奔腾翻涌。
随着其中一个人的呐喊，其他五人也是纷纷动手，开始朝着萧天冲来。
只见他们纷纷施展功法武技，有的掌风呼啸，有的拳影重重，有的腿影纵横…开始向着萧天杀来。
content_en:
When Li Qing laughed, he did not forget to signal the people around him to surround Xiao Tian and Ye Jingxin.
Speaking of which, Li Qing is also a celebrity. As the stall owners just said, he is an extremely lustful person with cruel methods. Basically, any woman he likes cannot escape his clutches and is tortured to death in the end.
That's why they are called sex demons.
Although everyone knows his evil deeds, because he is the son of the head of the Li family, and the Li family has become more and more arrogant and domineering in recent years, and Li Qing is also a master of the third level of the body training realm, he is ranked among the best among his peers in the small place of Nanling City.
So everyone had no choice but to swallow their anger.
This also caused Li Qing to act more unscrupulously.
It's not surprising that now they dare to target the Ye family's legitimate daughter.
Now Li Qing is surrounded by some young men from small families affiliated with the Li family, and they are all domineering and lustful people.
As the saying goes, birds of a feather flock together.
Moreover, everyone has a certain level of cultivation, and the lowest one is at the ninth level of Qi Refining.
This resulted in this small group becoming a cancer in the city, causing harm to the world.
Seeing the arrogance of Li Qing and others, Xiao Tian was also furious, especially for provoking his woman, which was definitely intolerable.
Moreover, Li Qing and others obviously do not take Xiao Tian seriously. After all, Xiao Tian is also a "celebrity" in Nanling City.
, how could I not know him? He is not talking to Xiao Tian now. One can imagine his attitude towards Xiao Tian.
Xiao Tian didn't waste any words, stepped forward and stood in front of Ye Jingxin.
From the beginning to the end, Xiao Tian's hand has been holding Ye Jingxin's little hand tightly.
Ye Jingxin felt Xiao Tian's care for her, which moved her very much.
Seeing Xiao Tian's appearance, Li Qing joked, "Hey, isn't this the second young master of the Xiao family? Why, you, a waste with no cultivation, want to stop me? I kindly advise you not to ask for trouble."
If I accidentally beat you to death, I will still have to resist your return to the Xiao family. This time and again, it will affect my intimacy with Miss Ye!
Hahahaha…”
Xiao Tian was not angry when he heard this, he was very calm.
The reason why he thought Xiao Tian was still a waste was because Xiao Tian had already restrained his aura as soon as he left the door of Ye's house.
Xiao Tian now looks like a proper mortal.
At this time, Xiao Tian said, "You'd better apologize to Miss Ye now, and I can consider letting you go, otherwise..."
"Otherwise, do you want to hit me? Come on, come on, try to see if you can hit me."
Hearing Xiao Tian's words, Li Qing seemed to have heard a joke and sneered with a look on his face that didn't deserve a beating.
"As the second son of the Xiao family, don't you know the difference between cultivators and ordinary people? I can stab you to death with just one finger!
Hahaha…”
Of course Xiao Tian knows how powerful cultivators are.
Practitioners first practice qi, opening up 108 acupuncture points on the body and then gathering them in the Zifu Dantian. Then, through the body-building technique, the spiritual qi is mobilized to forge the muscles and bones.
These are still the basics, so there is no doubt about the power of cultivators.
It's just that Xiao Tian is also a cultivator, just a special cultivator.
Xiao Tian said calmly, "There's so much nonsense, either apologize and get out, or just lie down."
When Li Qing heard that Xiao Tian was so careless about life and death, he stopped pretending.
He directly ordered: "Do it, don't worry, beat him to death or cripple him, I'll take it. Whoever can beat this kid first will be rewarded with five low-grade spiritual stones!"
! "
Hearing Li Qing's words, the six young masters who came with Li Qing immediately put themselves into position. At the same time, the Dantian in their bodies began to surge, and the spiritual energy around them began to surge.
As one of them shouted, the other five also took action and began to rush towards Xiao Tian.
I saw them all displaying their martial arts and martial arts. Some of them were whistling with wind, some had heavy fist shadows, and some had criss-crossed leg shadows... They began to kill towards Xiao Tian.
